title: A SiGe Integrated Active Phased Array Antenna for a 183GHz Water-Vapor Radiometer
venue: 2025 19th European Conference on Antennas and Propagation (EuCAP)
summary: This work integrates a passive antenna array and a three-stage low-noise amplifier in the same 130 nm SiGe BiCMOS process. The simulated design establishes a practical building block for a compact radiometer front end operating above 100 GHz.

title: A Non-Deployable, Folded-Dipole, UHF Antenna with Dual Circular Polarization for Nanosatellite Telemetry Applications
venue: IEEE Aerospace and Electronic Systems Magazine
summary: A compact folded-dipole array provides dual circular polarization for nanosatellite telemetry and telecommand without an in-orbit deployment mechanism. The lightweight, low-profile design is intended to maintain broad Earth coverage while reducing size and deployment risk.

title: An Integrated On-Chip SiGe Antenna in Dual 79 GHz and 140 GHz Bands for Automotive Sensing Applications
venue: 2025 19th European Conference on Antennas and Propagation (EuCAP)
summary: This dual-band on-chip antenna targets 79 GHz and 140 GHz automotive sensing. The design is translated from an ideal model into a fabrication-aware implementation in a 130 nm SiGe process, addressing the challenge of integrating antennas directly with millimeter-wave electronics.

title: 183GHz Cavity-Backed Spiral Radiometer Antenna with Dual Circular Polarization for Earth Observation Applications
venue: 2022 16th European Conference on Antennas and Propagation (EuCAP)
summary: This cavity-backed spiral antenna targets the 183 GHz atmospheric water-vapor line used in Earth observation. A scaled 7 GHz prototype provides a manufacturable measurement route for validating the extreme-high-frequency design and its dual-circular-polarization behavior.
